{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute average revenue per channel within each segment
# This adjusts for the confounding by customer_segment
stratified_revenue = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the total revenue per channel, stratified by segment
stratified_total = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the overall revenue per channel (unadjusted)
unadjusted_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Compare unadjusted vs stratified
unadjusted_revenue, stratified_total"}
